pr_title: Simplify SSE streaming to a single async generator
pr_description: Replace the `_sse_producer_cm` async-context-manager-plus-`AsyncExitStack` wiring with a plain `_async_stream_sse` async generator that runs the producer task group and keepalive loop inline. This removes the separate keepalive-inserter task and the intermediate `receive_keepalive` stream, since the generator can yield keepalive comments directly on timeout. Also drops the now-unused `ObjectReceiveStream` import.
